Lena (Sales): Client signed off on POC and requested immediate teardown of POC environment.
Diego Ramos: Do they require any retention window?
Lena (Sales): Legal says retain audit logs 60 days but keys/pools must be revoked now.
Priya Singh: Resources: hosted keys: hk_poc_x12, hk_poc_y34; dedicated pool: dl-poc-03; ephemeral cache prefix: poc_eu_77.
Diego Ramos: Plan: revoke hosted keys, disable routing, drain dl-poc-03, purge cache, snapshot redacted logs to compliance bucket.
Priya Singh: Commands I'll run:
```bash
redwoodctl keys revoke --id hk_poc_x12 && redwoodctl keys revoke --id hk_poc_y34
redwoodctl routes update --name poc-eu-route --disabled true
redwoodctl pools drain --name dl-poc-03 --timeout 900 && redwoodctl pools delete --name dl-poc-03 --force
redwoodctl kv purge --prefix poc_eu_77 --confirm
```
Ops-bot: Job started: poc/teardown by Priya (build #312).
security-bot: Reminder: redact IPs and PII before moving logs to compliance.
Diego Ramos: After revocation I'll run a smoke test to confirm 401s.
Lena (Sales): Please attach proof screenshots and S3 path to ticket #POC-9902. I'll notify client once artifacts present.
Ops-bot: Job completed successfully.
Priya Singh: Done: keys revoked, pool removed, cache purged. Audit snapshot at s3://compliance/poc-9902/60d/. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/tickets/POC-9902/artifacts
Lena (Sales): Thanks — keeping ticket open for audit retention period.
